Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Fix preview endpoint response format to include reportId at top level

This commit resolves the issue where the frontend was unable to display
report previews because the backend response was missing the required
reportId field at the top level.

Changes:
- Update GET /api/reports/<id>/preview endpoint response format
- Add reportId, reportTitle, and reportType fields at top level
- Maintain backward compatibility by keeping nested preview object
- Frontend now receives expected response format for generateReportFromExcel

The issue was that the backend was returning:
  { "success": true, "preview": { "report_id": 26, ... } }

But the frontend expected:
  { "reportId": 26, "reportTitle": "...", "reportType": "..." }

This fix ensures Railway returns 200 successfully and the frontend
can properly process and display report previews.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")
